Hi Julia —

Thanks again for taking the time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive that includes your platform and security folks: 

Recap (2 lines):
- You’re evaluating inference throughput for batch claims enrichment and a low-latency path for real-time triage.
- Primary constraints: multi-tenant data segmentation, audit logs retention, and predictable p50/p95 latency at scale.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep dive where we’ll:
- Walk through architecture (how Redwood routes requests, KV cache, and batching)
- Share perf numbers for similar workloads and quantization options
- Review security controls (VPC options, KMS integration, audit logs)

Can you confirm which of these two windows works best for your team (all times PT):
- Option A: Tue May 18 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Option B: Wed May 19 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Attendees we’d like on the call from your side: product owner, platform engineer, security lead. From Redwood: I’ll host and Ben Carter (solutions engineer) will join to cover the demo and perf tests.

If neither works, send 2x alternatives and I’ll convert to a calendar invite.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
